subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be accepted through the generic channel login/auth contract, or kept as a WhatsApp-owned entrypoint before either linked PR lands?
rationale: The requested fix is not only a local Baileys call; the active PRs add public CLI/plugin auth surface and change persisted WhatsApp credential handling, which requires maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
options.body: Keep the typed generic login-method or phone-number path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, live proof, and upgrade/session-state proof before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Surface
options.body: Rework the fallback so phone-code login stays local to the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause Until Dependency Proof Is Stronger
options.body: Keep the issue open while waiting for stronger Baileys pairing-code proof or upstream hardening before committing to a public entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic login-method or phone-number path, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix, QR compatibility, live proof, and upgrade/session-state proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin SDK/channel auth, docs, and auth-session boundaries where the history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
